cards.text: This is the testimony of John, the man sent from God to testify about the Light (John 1:6-7). The Jews of Jerusalem send priests and Levites to ask him one question: “Who are you?” Friend, that's a whole delegation for a question you could've sent in a group chat.

cards.question: John doesn't refuse to answer. When the priests and Levites ask who he is, what does John openly declare?

answers.text: I am a king of Israel

cards.text: So they ask: is he Elijah the prophet (1 Kings 18:36)? John says, “I am not.”

cards.question: True or false: When the visitors ask John if he is the Prophet, he says no.
The visitors need an answer for the people who sent them, so they ask John what he says about himself. How does John answer?

answers.text: With the words of a prophet
With the name of his family

cards.text: John answers in the words of Isaiah the prophet: he is “a voice of one calling in the wilderness…” They asked for a name, friend. He gave them a job description.

cards.question: In Isaiah's words, John is a voice calling in the wilderness. What does the voice call people to make straight?

cards.text: Then the Pharisees who had been sent step up with one more question for John. Pharisees are the strictest group in the Jewish faith (Acts 26:5).

cards.question: The Pharisees ask John, if he isn't the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet, then why does he ___?

cards.text: John answers, “I baptize with water,” but he isn't done. Then he tells them about One who is standing among them right now.

cards.question: John tells the Pharisees that among them stands One they do not ___.

cards.text: This One comes after John, and John says he isn't worthy to untie the straps of His sandals. Friend, that's the job NOBODY fights over, and John says he doesn't even qualify for it.

cards.question: John says he isn't worthy to untie the straps of this One's sandals. What does that show about this One?

answers.text: He is far greater than John
He is a servant like John
He has traveled a long way

cards.text: All this happens at Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing. That's where the whole delegation found him.
The next day, John sees Jesus coming toward him and says, “Look, the Lamb of God…” After all those nos, friend, John finally gets to point at somebody and say YES.

cards.question: John calls Jesus the Lamb of God. What does John say this Lamb takes away?

cards.text: Then John points back to something he said before. This is the man he meant, the one who comes after John but has surpassed him.

cards.question: True or false: John says this man has surpassed him because He was before John.

cards.text: Then John says, “I myself did not know Him…” Friend, he JUST introduced the man, and now he says THAT?

cards.question: John says he came baptizing with water so that Jesus might be ___ to Israel.

cards.text: Then John testifies about what he saw: “I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove…”

cards.question: True or false: John says the Spirit came down from heaven and then went back up.

cards.text: Then John says that line again: “I myself did not know Him…” But the One who sent John to baptize with water gave him a sign to watch for: the man he sees the Spirit come down and rest on.

cards.question: John baptizes with water. The One who sent John told him what the man of the sign will baptize with. What is it?
John has seen the sign and testified about it. Who does John say Jesus is?
